items.name: Potion
items.description: A bitter red tonic. Restores 30 health.

items.name: Ether
items.description: Shimmering blue. Restores 20 magic.

items.name: Stamina Tonic
items.description: Fully restores stamina.

items.name: Bread
items.description: A crusty loaf. Restores a little health and stamina.

items.name: Short Sword
items.description: Quick and light. A light weapon: fast swings, short reach.

items.name: Longsword
items.description: A medium weapon: balanced speed, reach and damage.

items.name: Greatsword
items.description: A heavy weapon: slow, long reach, hits very hard.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.description: Hold 2 to draw, let go to shoot. A full draw flies furthest and hits hardest.

items.name: Round Shield
items.description: A sturdy wooden shield. Worn with a melee weapon.

items.name: Iron Arrows
items.description: Plain arrows. You'll never run out.

items.name: Steel Arrows
items.description: Sharper and heavier. Nock them from the bag.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Supple and quiet.

items.name: Lantern
items.description: Lights the way in the dark. Switch it on or off in the bag, or assign it to the B button.

items.name: Strider Boots
items.description: Walk on water of any depth while they’re on; they switch off when you step back on land. Switch them on in the bag, or assign them to the B button.

items.name: Moon Amulet
items.description: Engraved with a tiny moon.

items.name: Old Key
items.description: Rusty, heavy, and clearly important.

items.name: Fire Shard
items.description: A splinter of ember crystal. Ready it with key 3 (or Y) to hurl firebolts.

items.name: Firewood
items.description: Dry branches. Feed a fire to keep it burning (+1 hour).

items.name: Stone
items.description: Rough stone, broken from a boulder.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Rusty rock from an iron vein. Smelt two into an iron ingot at a forge.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Rock flecked with gold. Smelt two into a gold ingot at a forge.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.description: Upgrades iron weapons and armor at a forge. Two make a steel ingot.

items.name: Steel Ingot
items.description: Upgrades steel weapons and armor at a forge.

items.name: Gold Ingot
items.description: Upgrades golden weapons and jewellery at a forge.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.description: Breaks boulders and ore veins: swing it at the rock.

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.description: A simple rod and line. Face a fishing spot by the water and press Talk (A / Enter) to cast; when the float bobs under, press it again.

items.name: Minnow
items.description: A little silver fish. Restores a bit of health.

items.name: Trout
items.description: A speckled trout, out by day. Restores health.

items.name: Night Eel
items.description: A slippery eel that only bites after dark. Restores magic.

items.name: Golden Koi
items.description: A rare golden fish. Collectors pay well for one.

items.name: Old Boot
items.description: Not a fish. Someone lost this a long time ago.

items.name: Fur
items.description: Soft and warm, perfect for a cloak or blanket.

items.name: Saddle
items.description: Your rented horse's saddle. Use it to send the horse home to its stable.

enemies.name: Terror Vine
enemies.description: Thorny spines given a twisted amalgamation of life by a cruel wizard. Attacks with venomous thorns!

quests.name: A Place by the Fire
quests.description: You've arrived on the meadow road as the light fades. Find someone who knows the area, and somewhere warm to spend the night.

quests.name: Slime Trouble
quests.description: Slimes have been getting into Mira's supplies. She'd be grateful if someone thinned them out.

objectives.text: Put out the ember slime by the fire

quests.name: Explore the Woods
quests.description: Search the woods for your sister, Alice.

nodes.name: Fighter
nodes.description: The basics of the blade. Opens the Might tree.

nodes.name: Quick Hands
nodes.description: Quicker in battle: Agility up, so turns come round sooner.

nodes.name: Steady Guard
nodes.description: Guard gives back more health.

nodes.name: Heavy Blows
nodes.description: Every melee hit does more damage.

nodes.name: Arms Training
nodes.description: Trained with medium weapons (longswords, rapiers): untrained, they hit for three quarters. Opens the masteries.

nodes.name: Heavy Arms
nodes.description: Trained with heavy weapons (greatswords, great axes, hammers): untrained, they hit for three quarters.

nodes.name: Light Mastery
nodes.description: Daggers and short swords: deadlier, with more critical hits.

nodes.name: Medium Mastery
nodes.description: Longswords and rapiers: the balanced path.

nodes.name: Heavy Mastery
nodes.description: Greatswords and great axes hit even harder.

nodes.name: Double Slash
nodes.description: An Addition: two timed strikes.

nodes.name: Volley
nodes.description: An Addition: four timed strikes with mixed buttons.

nodes.name: Crescent Storm
nodes.description: An Addition: seven fast strikes.

nodes.name: Archer
nodes.description: Arrows fly true. Opens archery.

nodes.name: Steady Draw
nodes.description: A steadier hand: Dexterity up (aim, critical hits, bow damage).

nodes.name: Eagle Eye
nodes.description: Lock on to enemies further away with a bow: spot them first and snipe one to start the battle with the first turns.

nodes.name: Power Shot
nodes.description: Arrows hit harder.

nodes.name: Shadow
nodes.description: Harder to see while sneaking: slip past foes, or catch them unaware for the first turns. Opens stealth.

nodes.name: Light Step
nodes.description: Make less noise while sneaking.

nodes.name: Backstab
nodes.description: Find the weak spots: more critical hits.

nodes.name: Silent Shot
nodes.description: An arrow from 5 tiles or more at a foe that hasn’t noticed you wounds it before the battle starts (and can finish it).

nodes.name: Assassinate
nodes.description: A sword strike on an ordinary foe that hasn’t noticed you ends it on the spot: no battle (not bosses).

nodes.name: Arcana
nodes.description: Spell bolts hit harder, and learn Fire. Opens the Magic tree.

nodes.name: Mana Thrift
nodes.description: Every spell costs less magic: bolts, and Light and Water Walk to cast and to keep going.

nodes.name: Empower
nodes.description: Spell bolts hit harder still, and Fire ranks up (Fire II, Fire III).

nodes.name: Frost Lore
nodes.description: Learn Frost; more ranks raise it.

nodes.name: Storm Lore
nodes.description: Learn Spark, lightning on every foe; more ranks raise it.

nodes.name: Radiance
nodes.description: The Light spell shines further.

nodes.name: Far Cast
nodes.description: Spell bolts fly further.

nodes.name: Toughness
nodes.description: More health.

nodes.name: Endurance
nodes.description: More stamina.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.description: More magic.

nodes.name: Mending
nodes.description: Learn Mend, healing for one of the party; more ranks raise it.

nodes.name: Quick Strike
nodes.description: One clean cut!

nodes.name: Double Slash
nodes.description: Dart would be proud.

nodes.name: Fellowship
nodes.description: The party sticks together: more health and stamina for everyone. Opens the Party tree.

nodes.name: Hardy Company
nodes.description: More health for everyone in the party.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description: More stamina for everyone in the party.

nodes.name: Battle Drill
nodes.description: Everyone’s melee hits do more damage.

nodes.name: Arcane Chorus
nodes.description: Everyone’s spells hit harder, with a little more magic.

nodes.name: Thick Skin
nodes.description: Everyone’s Endurance goes up: ailments take hold less often.

nodes.name: Quick Step
nodes.description: Everyone’s Agility goes up: quicker turns, more dodging.

nodes.name: Keen Eyes
nodes.description: Everyone’s Dexterity goes up: better aim and more critical hits.

nodes.name: Shield Wall
nodes.description: Everyone’s Defence and Magic Defence go up.

additions.name: Volley
additions.description: Four quick strikes with mixed buttons.

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.description: Win 5 battles without anyone taking damage.

spells.name: Fire
spells.description: A firebolt. Higher ranks burn hotter but take longer to call up.

spells.name: Frost
spells.description: A shard of ice that can chill.

spells.name: Mend
spells.description: Closes wounds on one of the party.

spells.name: Speed Boost
spells.description: Increase target's speed for the duration of the battle.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Someone (a friend, or a foe to undo its Slow) takes their turns half again as often, for a few turns.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: Someone’s turns come round much more slowly (or undo a Haste), for a few turns. Endurance can shrug it off.

spells.name: Rain Call
spells.description: Brings rain over the battle for five rounds: water spells hit harder, fire ones weaker.
